* Reduced LEGEND-200 LMFE detector-input model for ngspice.
* Derived from LEGEND-200_LMFE_CC4_Simplified.asc.
* The AD8139 differential-output section and op-amp supply filters are omitted.
* U2/U3 retain finite open-loop gain and gain-bandwidth through FINITE_OPAMP.

.model MX11RC NJF(VTO=-3 BETA=7m LAMBDA=4.7m RS=40 RD=40 CGS=0.7p CGD=1.0p)

.subckt BF862 1 2 3
Ld 1 4 1.1n
Ls 3 6 1.25n
Lg 2 5 0.78n
Rg 5 7 0.535
Cds 1 3 0.0001p
Cgs_pkg 2 3 1.05p
Cgd_pkg 1 2 0.201p
Co 4 6 0.35092p
J1 4 7 6 JBF862
.model JBF862 NJF(BETA=47.8m RD=0.8 RS=7.5 LAMBDA=37.3m VTO=-0.57093
+ IS=424.6p N=1 XTI=3 VTOTC=-2m CGD=7.4002p M=0.6015 PB=0.5 FC=0.5
+ CGS=8.289p KF=87.5e-18 AF=1)
.ends BF862

* Single-pole voltage op amp: LTspice opamp.sub pin order is inv, noninv, out.
* AOL=100k and GBW=10 MHz by default.
.subckt FINITE_OPAMP inv noninv out params: AOL=100k GBW=10Meg
Gerr 0 nint noninv inv 1m
Rdom nint 0 {AOL/1m}
Cdom nint 0 {1m/(6.283185307179586*GBW)}
Ebuf out 0 nint 0 1
Rdc out 0 1G
.ends FINITE_OPAMP

.model LMFE_SIGNAL_CABLE LTRA(len=1 R=3.78 L=241n C=87p)
* O2/O4 in the user's exported simplified netlist: output pair to head electronics.
* O1/O3 above are separate 1 m internal signal/feedback connections.
.model LMFE_HEAD_CABLE LTRA(len=10 R=32.81m L=262.5n C=93.5p)
* Pins: detector cathode/pickup node, J2 gate, output+, output-.
* The generated top-level deck supplies the Designer-configured HV cable.
* CDET is C19. V(outp,outn) corresponds to voltage across R30.
.subckt LEGEND_LMFE_FRONTEND cathode gate outp outn params: CDET=10p
V12 n12 0 12
VBIAS2_RAW n1p2 0 1.2
RBIAS2 vb2 n1p2 1k
CBIAS2 vb2 0 1u
VREFP vrefp 0 1.2
VREFN vrefn 0 0

RJFET_LOAD n12 cascode_drain 1.6k
JINPUT cascode_near gate 0 MX11RC
XCASCODE cascode_drain vb2 cascode_far BF862
OCASCODE cascode_near 0 cascode_far 0 LMFE_SIGNAL_CABLE

CDET cathode gate {CDET}

CFB gate fb_near 0.35p
RFB gate fb_near 1G
OFB fb_near 0 amp_out_n 0 LMFE_SIGNAL_CABLE

XU2 cascode_drain vrefp amp_out_p FINITE_OPAMP AOL=100k GBW=10Meg
RAVG_P avg amp_out_p 1k
XU3 avg vrefn amp_out_n FINITE_OPAMP AOL=100k GBW=10Meg
RAVG_N avg amp_out_n 1k
OHEAD_P amp_out_p 0 outp 0 LMFE_HEAD_CABLE
OHEAD_N amp_out_n 0 outn 0 LMFE_HEAD_CABLE
RDIFF outp outn 100
.ends LEGEND_LMFE_FRONTEND

Tlmfe out 0 cathode 0 Z0=50 TD=5.0540014e-08
